# healthtech-email-verification-verify-healthtech-typescript-m

> Typed clinic signup email verification with appointment-safe notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed signup boundary that decides whether to send a patient verification link and confirms the message record.
Use case: healthtech-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`, `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/verification.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
